errors.noCredential: To use the AI assistant you need your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or OpenRouter. You pay them directly, usually a few cents per email.
errors.invalidKey: {provider} rejected the key as invalid. Check that it was copied in full and that it has not expired.
errors.quota: Your {provider} account is out of credit. Top it up in their console, or switch to another provider.
errors.rateLimited: The provider asked us to wait. We will retry in {seconds} seconds automatically.

errors.invalidOutput: The model returned something we could not read. We will try once more.
errors.invalidOutputFinal: It failed twice in a row. Try simplifying the brief, or use a different model.
errors.timeout: The model did not respond within {seconds} seconds. A shorter brief sometimes helps.
errors.providerDown: {provider} is having an outage. You can switch to another provider in the meantime.
errors.contextTooLong: The brief is too long for this model.
errors.contentFiltered: The provider refused to process this content.
errors.saveFailed: The key could not be saved.
